John prepared the way by calling people to repent. What might need preparing in your heart for Jesus?
Straight after his baptism, the Spirit drove Jesus into the wilderness. What does this say about testing after a high point?
Simon and Andrew left their nets "immediately." What makes it hard for you to respond to Jesus quickly?
The people were amazed that Jesus taught with authority. Where do you need to let his words have authority?
After a busy night of healing, Jesus rose early to pray alone. What does this show about his priorities?
Jesus touched the man with leprosy and said, "I will; be clean." What does this show about Jesus' willingness to help?
Four friends carried the paralysed man and dug through the roof. Who could you bring to Jesus?
Jesus showed he has authority to forgive sins. What does it mean to you that Jesus can forgive?
Jesus called Levi and ate with sinners. Why does Jesus say he came for the sick?
Jesus speaks of new wine needing new wineskins. What new thing might Jesus be doing in you?
"The Sabbath was made for man." How can rest be a gift from God for you this week?
Jesus was grieved at their hardness of heart. What softens a heart toward God?
Crowds pressed in from everywhere to touch Jesus. What were they looking for, and what are you looking for?
Jesus called the twelve first "to be with him." How do you make time simply to be with Jesus?
Some thought Jesus was out of his mind. Why do people misunderstand Jesus?
Jesus says whoever does God's will is his family. What does belonging to Jesus' family mean to you?
Jesus tells of seed falling on different soils. Which soil describes you right now?
What are the "cares of the world" that choke the word in your life?
A lamp is meant to be put on a stand. How can the light you've received shine?
The seed grows "he knows not how." Where can you trust God to grow what you cannot see?
The disciples asked, "Do you not care that we are perishing?" When have you felt that way, and what did Jesus do?
The man among the tombs was beyond anyone's help, yet Jesus set him free. What does this show about Jesus' power?
The healed man was sent home to tell how much the Lord had done. What has the Lord done for you that you could share?
The woman thought, "If I touch even his garments." What does Jesus' response show about how he sees her?
Jesus told Jairus, "Do not fear, only believe." What fear do you need to bring to Jesus?
Jesus' hometown took offence at him. Why can familiarity make it hard to see Jesus clearly?
Jesus sent the twelve out with very little. What does this teach about relying on God?
John the Baptist told Herod the truth and paid with his life. What does faithfulness cost?
Jesus had compassion because they were like sheep without a shepherd. How does Jesus shepherd you?
Jesus came walking on the sea and said, "Take heart; it is I." What storm do you need his presence in?
People brought the sick wherever Jesus went. Who in your life needs his touch?
Jesus warns of honouring God with lips but not hearts. Where might your worship be just outward?
Jesus says evil comes from within. Why is the heart the place that needs changing?
The woman answered, "Even the dogs under the table eat the children's crumbs." What does her humble faith teach you?
Jesus took the deaf man aside and said, "Be opened." What do you need Jesus to open in you?
Again Jesus fed a crowd from very little. Why do we forget how Jesus has provided before?
Jesus asked, "Do you not yet understand?" What has Jesus shown you that you're still slow to grasp?
The blind man's sight came back in two stages. How might God be opening your eyes step by step?
Peter said, "You are the Christ." What does that confession mean to you?
Jesus says to deny yourself and take up your cross. What does that look like for you today?
A voice said, "This is my beloved Son; listen to him." What is Jesus saying that you need to listen to?
The father cried, "I believe; help my unbelief!" Where do you need to pray that prayer?
The disciples argued about who was greatest. How does Jesus redefine greatness?
Even a cup of water given in Jesus' name will not lose its reward. What small kindness can you show today?
Jesus takes sin seriously. What might you need to cut out of your life?
Jesus was indignant when children were turned away. How do you receive God's kingdom like a child?
Jesus looked at the rich man and loved him. What might Jesus be asking you to let go of?
"With God all things are possible." Where do you need to trust this today?
Jesus came "not to be served but to serve." Who can you serve this week?
Bartimaeus would not stop calling out. What do you want Jesus to do for you?
The crowds cried "Hosanna!" as Jesus entered Jerusalem. What does it mean to welcome Jesus as King?
The fig tree had leaves but no fruit. What fruit is Jesus looking for in your life?
Jesus called the temple a house of prayer for all nations. How can your life welcome others to God?
Jesus links prayer with forgiving others. Is there anyone you need to forgive before you pray?
The tenants rejected the vineyard owner's son. What does this parable reveal about God's patience?
"Render to God the things that are God's." What belongs to God in your life?
Jesus sums up the law as loving God and neighbour. Which do you find harder right now?
The widow gave all she had. What does her gift teach you about giving?
Jesus warned that troubles would come but "the end is not yet." How does this help in uncertain times?
Jesus promised the Spirit would give words when needed. When have you experienced that help?
"Heaven and earth will pass away, but my words will not." How does this steady you?
"Stay awake." What does being watchful for Jesus look like in daily life?
The woman poured costly ointment on Jesus and he defended her. What would beautiful devotion look like for you?
At the supper Jesus said, "This is my blood of the covenant." What does his sacrifice mean to you?
In Gethsemane Jesus prayed, "Not what I will, but what you will." Where do you need to surrender your will?
Peter broke down and wept after denying Jesus. What hope is there after failure?
Pilate released Barabbas and handed Jesus over. What does it mean that Jesus took the place of the guilty?
The soldiers mocked Jesus as King. Why did Jesus endure such shame?
Seeing how Jesus died, the centurion said, "Truly this man was the Son of God!" What do you see at the cross?
The women watched, and Joseph of Arimathea took courage. What do their quiet acts of love teach you?
The young man said, "He has risen; he is not here." What difference does the resurrection make to you?
The message was for the disciples "and Peter." Why do you think Peter was named?
The disciples did not believe at first. Why is the resurrection hard to believe, and why can we trust it?
Jesus sent them to proclaim the good news to the whole creation. Who could you share it with?
